text: The changed section 31if7sjf (spec-operation › Prezentacja — the `stateSlice` row dropped from the slot table) describes the `spec-operation` type of the specification project's OWN project-local plugin (`c4s-plugin-app-spec`, living in the specification repository under `.claude4spec/plugins/`), not a type of this code repository: no `spec-operation` source exists here, and the implementer may not edit outside the repo. Read-only check of that plugin's `src/entity/spec-operation/frontend/module.tsx`: it already supplies renderChip/renderCard/renderRow/renderOverlay + useGetBySlug/listByTags, no sidebarTab, no routes/detailPanel, no editorExtensions and no stateSlice, registered from its browser entry via registerFrontendModule — i.e. it matches the section at 2.1.20. What this repo owns is the host contract the table relies on (no `stateSlice` slot in `FrontendModule`; a listable but tab-less hidden type is accepted and listed); that is what `[section:31if7sjf]` asserts. Suggestion: nothing to change in the spec; if the spec-operation module should be verified by this build, the workflow brief should name the plugin repo.
